selection_rule.yield_constraint: candidate evidence yield must be at least 90% of V0 yield (>= 402 of 446 rows)
selection_rule.tie_1: if FAIL rates differ by <1 percentage point, prefer higher PASS_EXACT rate
selection_rule.tie_2: if exact rates also differ by <1 percentage point, prefer the earlier/less complex prompt

v1.mutation: Explicit source grounding and exact-substring eligibility definition
v1.rationale: The V0 failure audit found non-verbatim reconstruction even though general copying rules were already present; V1 makes source membership the explicit eligibility test.
